title: Phone walk-through shows links: a URL in Tally's reply (or an item) is visible and tappable while the phone is in walk-through mode

requirements.text: When a reply to a [phone] message contains a link, the phone walk-through shows it as a tappable link on the item it belongs to
requirements.check: manual: TJ opens a link from the walk-through on his phone

text: Built: Focus.kt link pills (tap opens browser), WalkPlan.linksFor matches reply links to the item whose task its paragraph names (else all items), URLs never spoken; 4 new unit tests, 22/22 pass. Tally rule in Voice.swift: links as markdown in written reply, not in say; takes effect on next Mac app install. Pixel not on adb; shipped via R2 link, version 0.1.454954. Waiting on TJ to open a link from the walk.

evidence: TJ on his phone: 'i see the links!' (links show in the walk-through; he did not say whether he tapped one)

answers.observed: TJ reported seeing the link pills in the walk on build 0.1.455005
answers.cause: Focus.kt Links pills fed by WalkPlan.linksFor; 22/22 unit tests
answers.absence: Not observed: a tap opening the browser; LocalUriHandler is the standard path
answers.assumption: Tally puts links as markdown in the written reply per the Voice.swift rule
answers.falsify: Tapping a pill does nothing, or a link lands on the wrong item
